must: Search the 21st.dev registry before hand-writing a UI primitive
Install registry components into src/components/ui via npx @21st-dev/cli@latest add
Animate every interactive surface with framer-motion (springs, not linear easing)
Use AnimatePresence for mount/unmount and the layout prop for reorder/resize
Animate only transform, opacity, and filter; keep transitions 0.15s-0.5s
Dark-first surfaces built from Tailwind v4 tokens in src/styles.css
Accessible semantics: real buttons, labels, focus-visible states, sufficient contrast
avoid: Inventing components that already exist in the registry
Static interactive surfaces with no motion
CSS keyframes where a framer-motion primitive exists
Heavy drop shadows, pure-black backgrounds, or gradient-text overuse
Placeholder lorem ipsum copy or fake data tables in shipped UI
New dependencies for what an installed package already covers

decisions.decision: framer-motion is the single motion runtime
decisions.rationale: one dependency, springs + gestures + layout + AnimatePresence in one API

decisions.decision: dark-first theme with translucent card surfaces
decisions.rationale: matches the control-room aesthetic; readable for long agent sessions
